fuente.titulo: Pope: Progress must not leave new ruins in its wake

titular: Pope warns progress must not leave new ruins
bajada: Leo XIV meets 'Fratelli Tutti' dialogue group on social and environmental challenges
caption: Pope Leo XIV met with participants in the 'Fratelli Tutti: North-South Socio-Environmental Dialogue' meeting at the Vatican, urging shared responsibility in facing social, economic and technological change. Source: Vatican News, Sept 12, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A simple wooden globe resting on a stone Vatican courtyard bench at dusk, placed in the upper right third, with the empty cobblestone square open and unobstructed on the left and center.
